operations.what: a request to the hub route /v1/tools/{op} (multi-instance mode, before the operation runs)

causes.name: Malformed
causes.doc: the request body or its envelope is not valid JSON, or its op does not match the route

causes.name: UnknownOperation
causes.doc: the route names an operation that the hub does not forward

causes.name: Identity
causes.doc: the hub cannot tie the request to a configured instance (unknown node, bad token, address mismatch)

causes.name: RequestConflict
causes.doc: the request ID was used before for a different request

causes.name: Expired
causes.doc: the request ID is older than the hub's replay window (24 h), so it is not executed again

causes.name: Overloaded
causes.doc: the hub is busy and refused the request; the caller may retry later

causes.name: OutcomeUnknown
causes.doc: the hub accepted the request and its operation failed before the reply could be sent; the outcome is unknown, so the request is not retried

operations.what: the subcommand agentbus hub (the hub listener)

causes.name: InvalidConfig
causes.doc: the hub configuration (HUB_LISTEN, HUB_AUTH, certificate, instance list) is missing or invalid

causes.name: Listen
causes.doc: the hub cannot listen on HUB_LISTEN or cannot load its certificate

causes.name: Socket
causes.doc: the hub cannot create, bind, or secure its local unix domain socket

causes.name: MissingCredentials
causes.doc: authorization header, token, or client address is missing

causes.name: WrongToken
causes.doc: the provided bearer token is invalid

causes.name: UnknownNode
causes.doc: the peer node is not in the allowed instances list

causes.name: AddressMismatch
causes.doc: the client source address does not match the configured address for this instance

causes.name: DuplicateInstanceName
causes.doc: an instance with this name is already connected with an active lease

causes.name: LocalAPIFailed
causes.doc: failed to query the local tailscaled LocalAPI socket

causes.name: InvalidMode
causes.doc: the configured HUB_AUTH mode is unknown

causes.name: InvalidConfig
causes.doc: the hub URL, authentication settings or timeout is invalid

causes.name: Malformed
causes.doc: the hub returned an invalid or incompatible response

causes.name: Unavailable
causes.doc: the hub could not be reached within the bounded retry budget

causes.name: Malformed
causes.doc: the registration body, manifest, or protocol version is invalid

causes.name: Identity
causes.doc: the manifest name or owner does not match the authenticated peer

causes.name: DuplicateInstanceName
causes.doc: another daemon holds a live lease for this instance name

causes.name: Entropy
causes.doc: a secure lease token could not be generated

causes.name: Malformed
causes.doc: the heartbeat body, manifest, or protocol version is invalid

causes.name: Identity
causes.doc: the heartbeat does not belong to the authenticated lease owner

causes.name: UnknownInstance
causes.doc: the instance has never registered

causes.name: LeaseExpired
causes.doc: the lease has expired and requires registration

causes.name: StaleLease
causes.doc: the token or generation belongs to an obsolete lease

causes.name: StaleSequence
causes.doc: the heartbeat sequence would replace newer task state
